messages:
jordan: Hi all 12 Ib4m planning my phased return after parental leave and want to run the plan by you. Thinking 50% FTE for 10 weeks starting 2026-06-01. Need clarity on benefits continuation, payroll coding, equipment for home setup, and arranging coverage for my PR review weeks (weeks 1-4).
people-ops: Congrats Jordan! :tada: Please fill out the Phased Return form: https://hr.redwood.example/phased-return. Select 50% and 10w; that will kick off payroll + benefits proration.
michelle: Payroll note: use code PT50-2026 on the form so we can apply the right deductions and subsidy proration. Equity vesting will remain unchanged but comp ops will send a confirmation email after processing.
liam: I can cover PR reviews week 1 & 2 and pair with @tara for weeks 3 & 4. Jordan, which days will you be online?
jordan: Mostly Tue/Thu remote, Wed in-office. I'll block Mon/Fri for childcare.
tara: I'll take point for handoffs. Suggest we create a lightweight checklist for the reviewer: merge policy, CI flake checklist, and contact fallback. I can draft it.
people-ops: Equipment: we can ship a USB-C dock + 24" monitor if you need it. Add shipping address on the form. Typical ship ETA 7-10 business days after approval. If you need expedited, note that on the form and we'll try to accommodate.
jordan: Do I need new FMLA forms for the phased return or is the existing leave record enough? Don't want delays.
people-ops: No new FMLA paperwork required if the leave is continuous and dates match the original request. If you extend beyond 10 weeks or change FTE we may request updates.
michelle: Childcare subsidy question: the subsidy will be pro-rated for 50%. We'll calculate and show the monthly adjustment on your upcoming paystub. If you'd like an estimate beforehand DM me.
liam: On-call routing: we should mark Jordan as reduced-hours in the rota so alerts escalate after 21:30 local. @people-ops can you add the routing flag?
people-ops: Done. We'll add flag and a note on the on-call page. Suggested snippet to paste in rota: ```if user.status == \"reduced-hours\" then escalate_after(21:30)```
jordan: Awesome. Also wondering about lactation room access 12 need a guaranteed 9-9:30am slot Wed mornings for ~8 weeks.
people-ops: We can reserve Wed 09:009:30 for 10 weeks. Confirm and we'll lock the calendar.
jordan: Confirmed, please lock it. Thanks.
tara: For coverage hiring: recommend a 0.3 FTE contract to handle async reviews and chase PRs during your return. @liam can you file a short-term contractor req?
liam: Yes, will open the req today and tag people-ops for onboarding checklist. Candidate ETA ~2 weeks.
michelle: Quick payroll reminder: once form submitted, changes process on next payroll cycle. If you need retro processing let me know.
hr-bot: Reminder: Submit the phased-return form within 7 business days to guarantee equipment shipping before start date.
jordan: Submitted the form and added my address + note about expedited shipping. Thanks everyone 60a
people-ops: Received. Next steps: 1) people-ops to confirm equipment ship date (ETA 8 business days) 2) michelle to calculate childcare subsidy proration 3) liam/tara to publish coverage rota + contractor req 4) people-ops to lock lactation room. We'll update this thread when each item is complete.
michelle: I'll DM you the subsidy calc once payroll posts it.
jordan: Great, really appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
